output_document.summary: Located incident records from Q3 2024 showing that clients were knocked offline when API rate limits were changed without sufficient warning (lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute without 24 hours notice, causing 2-4 hour outages). Three critical lessons learned: (1) all limit changes must require 72-hour advance notice to clients, (2) clients must have a documented escalation path for issues, and (3) rate limit headers should be included in all API responses to provide visibility.
